title: 三脚式フロアイーゼル
description: 交流施設の美術室・制作室に置く木製三脚イーゼル。開いた前二脚と折り畳み式の後脚、中央マスト、上下の固定クランプ、下受け皿と落下止め、金属の開き止め、無地キャンバスと裏の木枠を造形。キャンバスは一式に含まれ、絵画・作者名・図柄はありません。調整や折り畳み動作、構造安全の検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.934 × 1.862 × 0.877 m、4,228三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wooden tripod easel for community art rooms and studios. It includes splayed front legs, rear folding-style leg, center mast, fixed upper/lower clamps, lower tray/retaining lip, metal spreaders and a blank canvas with rear stretcher frame. The canvas belongs to this one assembly; no painting, artist name or artwork is included. Adjustment, folding motion and structural-safety validation are not supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.934 × 1.862 × 0.877 m; 4,228 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
